# Epic Global Inc.

> Epic Global Inc. is an Amazon-first wholesale trade partner and marketplace operator, selling on Amazon since 2015. It buys brands' inventory upfront at wholesale and sells it on Amazon, plus Walmart, eBay, TikTok Shop and other international marketplaces, paying for the advertising, marketplace fees and fulfillment itself so incentives stay aligned. It is not an agency: no retainers, hourly rates or consulting packages.

## Key facts
- Model: Buy, Sell, Advertise, Protect. Epic buys inventory upfront at wholesale, sells it at retail, funds the advertising, and protects price and catalog (Brand Registry authorization, MAP enforcement, removing unauthorized sellers).
- What Epic does: purchases inventory at wholesale pricing; operates retail sales across approved marketplaces; covers operating expenses including advertising, marketplace fees and fulfillment; gives brands a shared dashboard from day one, monthly SKU-level reports and quarterly business reviews.
- Global expansion: launches and scales brands on new marketplaces and in new regions, with localization and compliance.
- Marketplaces: Amazon first (Epic's main marketplace), plus Walmart, eBay, TikTok Shop, Temu and select international marketplaces (13 marketplace platforms) across North America, Europe and other growth regions.
- Who Epic serves: brands that want to scale on marketplaces without building an internal marketplace operations team. Best fit is typically brands that already have traction and need better execution, control and expansion capacity.
- Founder and CEO: Glen Jensen. He built Epic on a wholesale partnership instead of the agency model: Epic buys the inventory, invests its own capital, and runs the marketplace advertising, logistics and execution.
- Track record: works with 50+ brands; sells on Amazon US as "Epic Global", rated 4.9 out of 5 from 9,600+ customer ratings (October 2026), and on Walmart as Epic Global Inc.
- On Amazon since: 2015
- Office: 333 S 520 W Ste 250, Lindon, UT 84042, United States
- Contact: info@epicglobalinc.com
- Get started: [Free marketplace assessment](https://www.epicglobalinc.com/campaigns/marketplace-assessment)

## Common questions (answers from the FAQ)
- Does Epic charge retainers or fees? No. Epic earns its margin by buying inventory at wholesale and selling at retail, and pays for advertising, marketplace fees and fulfillment itself.
- Who sets the retail price? Epic sets it on the marketplaces it operates and sells at or above the brand's minimum advertised price (MAP), and enforces MAP against other sellers.
- Does the brand keep its Brand Registry, listings and reviews? Yes. The brand keeps Brand Registry and authorizes Epic to sell; Epic sells on the existing product pages, so listings, reviews and sales rank carry over.
- How long is a typical contract? Typically 3 years.
- Who handles fulfillment? Epic does, and pays for it, mostly through Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) plus Epic's own US warehouse.
- Full list: [FAQ](https://www.epicglobalinc.com/faq)

### Marketplace operations

- [Catalog QA Checklist](https://www.epicglobalinc.com/knowledge-base/catalog-qa-checklist): a catalog-level audit checklist for finding suppressed listings, broken variations, bad data and price conflicts that cost sales
- [Variation Strategy Basics: How Should You Set Up Product Variations on Amazon?](https://www.epicglobalinc.com/knowledge-base/variation-strategy-basics): how Amazon parent-child variations work, when to group products, when to keep them separate, and how to avoid broken families

### Advertising operations
- [Campaign Structure Playbook: How Should You Structure Amazon Ad Campaigns?](https://www.epicglobalinc.com/knowledge-base/campaign-structure-playbook): how to build a baseline Amazon ads structure with campaigns by objective, match type and SKU priority, plus naming rules and weekly checks
- [Search Term Harvesting Playbook: How Do You Turn Search Term Reports Into Better Campaigns?](https://www.epicglobalinc.com/knowledge-base/search-term-harvesting-playbook): how to mine the Amazon search term report: promote converting terms to exact match, negate waste, and keep campaigns from competing
- [Creative Testing Loop: How Do You Test Images and Content to Improve Amazon Conversion?](https://www.epicglobalinc.com/knowledge-base/creative-testing-loop): a repeatable cycle for testing one listing element at a time on Amazon, keeping the winner and starting the next test

### Inventory and forecasting

## What Epic does not do
- No retainers, hourly rates or project fees
- No a la carte services or consulting packages
- No advice without execution
- No revenue share without inventory ownership
